newsitem.title: MEXICO: General Motors kicks off new Mexico plant.
newsitem.headline: General Motors kicks off new Mexico plant.

text.p: General Motors on Friday inaugurated a new $350 million paint plant at its vehicle assembly facility in the northern Mexican town of Ramos Arizpe.

"Total investment in the plant by General Motors and its suppliers was about $350 million," Gary Cowger, head of General Motors in Mexico, said during the inauguration of the new plant, an event attended by President Ernesto Zedillo.
Cowger said General Motors had become the leader in Mexico's car market, although he provided no figures.
He said the carmakers' Ramos Arizpe and Silao units in Mexico had recently won the J.D. Powers quality awards for its Cavalier and Suburban models.
